bibl.title: Another eyewitness to the plague described by Cyprian, with notes on the "Persecution of Decius".
bibl.seg: Kyle Harper, Another eyewitness to the plague described by Cyprian, with notes on the "Persecution of Decius".
bibl.note: Supplement to: Kyle Harper, Pandemics and passages to late antiquity: rethinking the plague of c.249-270 described by Cyprian, JRA 28 (2015) pp. 223-260, figg. - Refers to the De laude martyrii (DLM), a text preserved within the corpus of Cyprian's works, written probably c.252-253 in the orbit of the great Carthaginian cleric. The pandemic mentioned in DLM can be considered at least a partial impetus for enforcing a universal sacrifice under the reign of Decius and his successors (not necessarily conceived as an anti-Christian measure).
